title: My Family Photo
description: Three short recordings about a family photo and the people in it.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Looking at a photo
parts.intro: You will hear Ben and Anna looking at a photo.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Who is this, Ben?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: This is my family. This is my mum and this is my dad.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Who is the little girl?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: She is my sister. Her name is Kate.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: She is very small! How old is she?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: She is four.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: We are all smiling in the photo.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: You have a lovely family.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I like this photo. My grandma took it last summer.

parts.title: Part 2 · My grandma
parts.intro: You will hear Anna talking about her grandma.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: This is my grandma. She has white hair and big glasses.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: She likes cooking. She makes very good soup.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: She has a cat. The cat is black.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: I visit her every Sunday. We have lunch together.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: I love her very much.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Her house is next to the river. It is a lovely place.

parts.title: Part 3 · Brothers
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and Nam talking about brothers.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Nam, do you have a brother?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, I have two brothers.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Are they big?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: One is big and one is small.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I have a brother too. He is tall.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: My brothers are funny. We play games every day.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: You are lucky, Nam.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: They are good brothers. They help me with my homework.

questions.text: What are Ben and Anna looking at?
questions.explanation: Ben says, "This is my family" about the photo.
Ben says she is his sister.

questions.text: What does Anna's grandma have on her face?

questions.explanation: Anna says the cat is black. White is her grandma's hair.

questions.text: How many brothers does Nam have?
questions.explanation: Nam says he has two brothers.
Mai says her brother is tall.
Mai says, "I have a brother too."
